# CLYVEXA — AI & Software Solutions

> CLYVEXA is a professional AI and software engineering company founded by **Er. Debadattaa Jena** (Founder, CEO & Proprietor), based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. Founded February 16, 2026. CLYVEXA builds custom web development, AI chatbots, autonomous AI agents, voice bots, mobile applications, and cloud infrastructure for businesses.

## Services

- **Website Development:** Custom, responsive websites with React/Next.js, e-commerce, PWA, SEO — from $999
- **AI Chatbots:** Intelligent conversational AI with NLP, multi-language, 24/7 support — from $2,499
- **AI Agents:** Autonomous agents for complex tasks, machine learning, decision automation — from $3,999
- **Voice Bots:** Speech-recognition AI assistants, natural voices, multi-platform — from $1,999
- **Mobile Applications:** iOS/Android apps via React Native and Flutter
- **Cloud Solutions:** AWS infrastructure, DevOps, auto-scaling, security
